---
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(ggplot2)

nhanes <- read.csv("../data/cleaned_NHANES.csv")
```

Row {data-height=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Age Distribution by Gender

```{r}
ggplot(data = nhanes, aes(x = age, fill = gender)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Age",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Gender")
```

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Participants Age 21 or Older

```{r}
age_21_percent <- mean(nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

gauge(age_21_percent,
      min = 0,
      max = 100,
      symbol = "%",
      sectors = gaugeSectors(
        success = c(50, 100),
        warning = c(25, 50),
        danger = c(0, 25)
      ))
```

### Average Systolic BP Above 120 mm Hg

```{r}
average_sbp <- rowMeans(nhanes[, c("systolic_bp_1",
                                   "systolic_bp_2",
                                   "systolic_bp_3",
                                   "systolic_bp_4")],
                        na.rm = TRUE)

high_sbp_percent <- mean(average_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100

valueBox(
  value = paste0(round(high_sbp_percent, 1), "%"),
  caption = "Average SBP > 120 mm Hg"
)
```
